info.syllabusName: Dẫn luận văn học (Introduction to Literature)
info.description:
This course equips students with th
e skills to approach literary works and concepts in literature such as figures of speech, sound effects, rhetorical devices, plot and setting, theme, characters, conflicts, etc. and helps students familiarize with some of famous British and American works (short stories and poems) and ways to interpret them.

clos.loDetails: Understand the basic literary concepts; know how to analyze topic, plot, point of view... in literature
Recognize literary concepts, have basic orientations for related courses like British Literature and American Literature.
Be aware of the course importance and create self-study habits to prepare for future career
Enrich their human values by analyzing and extracting those from famous literary works.
